review_improvement: Reframes an unsafe blind uninstall into a signed, recoverable downgrade transaction with complete postflight and one controlled Level-5 diagnostic.
independent_technical_reasoning: A downgrade has greater rollback risk than a normal install because the current working stack is intentionally removed and older dependencies may not match the kernel. Therefore evidence must prove both transaction completeness and recoverability. Level-5 health can reveal operational faults after change, but cannot prove artifact provenance or package integrity and remains a separate duplicate-code checkpoint.
